description: Issue #49, second half: the issue itself writes both "web/src/lib/filter.ts" and the shorter "src/lib/filter.ts". At most one is the file it means, and the shorter is a path-boundary suffix of the longer, so it is dropped from suspected_files (= the worker's scope.allow) rather than widening it by a directory the issue never named — and the drop is reported as a shadowed_file_candidate warning, which makes the run partial, instead of being discarded silently.
